# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Na mem, a Zamba wom, ne onga kom ma ne me yem Wò me lugu fe wò. Étié te, ma yebe évodi dzam ayi ngul dzoë, mebua mam ayi akuma doë. Zambe mfë avegan ki ai Wò, Nkè a mbedzam, enyo ato’o ai émen.
